rows.value: 25% standard, 13% and 5% reduced, 0%; registration above €60,000 of annual supplies. Paid by consumers (collected by registered businesses). Zakon o porezu na dodanu vrijednost.
rows.note: Checklist item D1

source.title: Porezna uprava: PDV

rows.label: Consumption tax, municipal (porez na potrošnju) [municipal]
rows.value: Up to 3% of the selling price of alcoholic drinks, wine, beer and soft drinks served in catering outlets, excluding VAT. Paid by catering businesses (on drinks sold). Zakon o lokalnim porezima NN 115/16, 101/17, 114/22, 114/23, 152/24.
rows.note: Checklist item D2

source.title: Porezna uprava: Porez na potrošnju

rows.label: Excise duties and special taxes (trošarine i posebni porezi) [national]
rows.value: Beer €5.31 per % vol per hl; spirits €796.34 per hl of pure alcohol; cigarettes €59.10 per 1,000 + 34% of the retail price (minimum €130.60); unleaded petrol €457.31 and diesel €290.00 per 1,000 litres; soft drinks from €2.65 per hl; roasted coffee €0.80 per kg. Paid by producers and importers (passed on to consumers). Zakon o trošarinama; Zakon o posebnom porezu na kavu i bezalkoholna pića.
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise-environment

source.title: Carinska uprava: Visine i način obračuna trošarina: Duhanske prerađevine i duhanski proizvodi

rows.label: Property tax (porez na nekretnine) [municipal]
rows.value: €0.60 to €8.00 per m² of usable area a year, set by each city or municipality. Paid by owners of residential property (domestic and foreign individuals and companies). Zakon o lokalnim porezima NN 115/16, 101/17, 114/22, 114/23, 152/24.
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax

source.title: Porezna uprava: Porez na nekretnine

rows.label: Property transfer tax (porez na promet nekretnina) [municipal]
rows.value: 3% of the market value; not due where VAT is charged on the supply; exemptions for close family; refund for young first-time buyers. Paid by the buyer or other acquirer, including heirs and donees. Zakon o porezu na promet nekretnina.
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer

source.title: Porezna uprava: Kupac, davatelj uzdržavanja i drugi stjecatelj nekretnine

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (porez na nasljedstva i darove) [regional]
rows.value: 4% on cash, receivables, securities and movables worth more than €6,700 each; spouses, descendants, ascendants and adopted children exempt; real estate pays the 3% transfer tax instead. Paid by heirs and donees (county revenue). Zakon o lokalnim porezima NN 115/16, 101/17, 114/22, 114/23, 152/24.
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance

rows.value: Annual: cars €27 to €199 by engine power and age (up to 10 years old); one-off special tax by CO2 emissions and price, electric vehicles exempt; vessel tax €13 to €664 a year. Paid by vehicle owners (annual, county tax); buyers and importers (one-off special tax). Zakon o lokalnim porezima; Zakon o posebnom porezu na motorna vozila.

rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff; EUR 150 duty relief until 30 June 2026, then EUR 3 per item; 25% import VAT; EUR 430 / 300 traveller allowance (EUR 150 under 15); 40 cigarettes except by air (200); EUR 10,000 cash declaration. Paid by importers and travellers. Regulations (EC) 1186/2009, (EU) 2026/382 and 2018/1672; Directive 2007/74/EC.

rows.label: Digital-nomad stay and new residents (expat regime) (privremeni boravak digitalnih nomada) [national]
rows.value: No income tax on pay from a foreign employer under digital-nomad status; returnee relief for Croatian emigrants; no expat regime for other foreign nationals. Paid by non-EU remote workers. Zakon o strancima; Zakon o porezu na dohodak art. 9.
rows.note: Checklist item H3

rows.value: Electricity EUR 0.50 per MWh (business use) or EUR 1.00 per MWh (non-business use); natural gas for heating EUR 0.54 or EUR 1.08 per MWh; natural gas as motor fuel EUR 0. Paid by electricity and gas suppliers, passed on to consumers. Zakon o trošarinama art. 96; Uredba o visini trošarina na energente i električnu energiju (NN 156/22).
rows.note: Checklist item D5

rows.value: Initial fee by vehicle category (HRK 33.25 for cars, 76.00 for vans, 304.00 for buses, 456.00 for heavy goods vehicles) times correction coefficients for engine, fuel, CO2 emissions and age (hybrids 0.5); paid yearly. Paid by owners of motor vehicles. Zakon o Fondu za zaštitu okoliša i energetsku učinkovitost art. 16; Uredba NN 114/14, 147/14 and 2/21.

rows.label: Tourist tax (turistička pristojba) [regional]
rows.value: Per person per night, set by each county and the City of Zagreb within national limits: HRK 10.00 to 20.00 (EUR 1.33 to 2.65) from 1 April to 30 September and HRK 7.00 to 14.00 (EUR 0.93 to 1.86) otherwise; camps HRK 8.00 to 15.00 and 5.00 to 10.00; private accommodation pays a yearly lump sum per bed. Paid by overnight guests (collected by the accommodation provider); private hosts pay the lump sum. Zakon o turističkoj pristojbi (NN 52/19, 32/20, 42/20); Pravilnik o najnižem i najvišem iznosu turističke pristojbe (NN 71/19).

rows.label: Personal income tax (porez na dohodak) [national]
rows.value: Lower rate up to €60,000 of annual tax base and higher rate above, set by each city and municipality (20% / 30% where no decision); personal allowance €600 a month. Paid by residents on worldwide income, non-residents on Croatian income. Zakon o porezu na dohodak.

rows.label: Municipal surcharge on income tax (surtax) (prirez porezu na dohodak) [municipal]
rows.value: None: the municipal surtax (prirez) was abolished from January 2024. Paid by no one. Zakon o porezu na dohodak (2023 reform).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Croatia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A3
rows.source_title: Porezna uprava: Tablica poreznih stopa godišnjeg poreza na dohodak za 2026. godinu (xlsx, linked from 'Porezne stope godišnjeg poreza na dohodak'; source: decisions of local units published in Narodne novine, state on 1 January 2026)
rows.label: Municipal income tax rates (porezne stope gradova i općina) [municipal]
rows.value: Each of 556 cities and municipalities sets its lower and higher rate within statutory limits (up to 23% / 33% in the City of Zagreb); see the county pages. Paid by residents (rates of the place of residence). Zakon o porezu na dohodak art. 19.a.

rows.label: Capital gains tax for individuals (porez na dohodak od kapitalnih dobitaka) [national]
rows.value: 12% (final) on gains on financial assets; 24% on gains from real estate and property rights. Paid by individuals. Zakon o porezu na dohodak.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Croatia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: capital-income
rows.source_title: Porezna uprava: Porez na dobit
rows.label: Withholding on dividends, interest and royalties (porez po odbitku) [national]
rows.value: Individuals: dividends and interest 12% final. Companies abroad: 15% on interest and royalties, 10% on dividends, 25% to EU-listed non-cooperative jurisdictions. Paid by the payer withholds it. Zakon o porezu na dohodak; Zakon o porezu na dobit.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Croatia: the complete list

rows.source_title: Porezna uprava: Oporezivanje djelatnosti iznajmljivanja smještaja turistima
rows.label: Rental income: lump-sum tax on holiday lets; pension income (paušalni porez na dohodak od iznajmljivanja smještaja) [municipal]
rows.value: €20 to €300 per bed (or camp unit) a year, set by the municipality by tourism-development category; 50% reduction of the advance tax on pensions. Paid by private hosts renting rooms, flats and camp pitches to tourists; pensioners. Zakon o porezu na dohodak.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Croatia: the complete list

rows.source_title: Porezna uprava: Nerezidenti
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (porez na dohodak nerezidenata od nesamostalnog rada) [national]
rows.value: Taxed on Croatian employment income through payroll; EU and EEA residents may claim dependants in the annual return; resident after 183 days of habitual abode. Paid by non-resident employees (the employer withholds the advance tax). Zakon o porezu na dohodak; Opći porezni zakon.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Croatia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B1
rows.source_title: Porezna uprava: Doprinosi: informiranje o općim pravilima, stopama i poreznom obvezniku (datum ažuriranja: 8. siječnja 2025.)
rows.label: Social security contributions (doprinosi za obvezna osiguranja) [national]
rows.value: Employee pension 20% up to 6 × the average wage a month; employer health insurance 16.5% with no ceiling. Paid by employees (pension 15% + 5% second pillar, or 20%) and employers (health 16.5%). Zakon o doprinosima.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Croatia: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B2
rows.source_title: Hrvatski sabor: Prijedlog zakona o izmjenama Zakona o doprinosima, PZ 80 (Vlada Republike Hrvatske, 2024), explanatory part and text of the Act
rows.label: Employer levies other than health insurance (doprinos za zapošljavanje, zaštita zdravlja na radu) [national]
rows.value: None: the employment (1.7%) and workplace-health (0.5%) contributions were abolished in 2018; health insurance is the only employer contribution on salary. Paid by no one. Zakon o doprinosima (2018 amendments).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Croatia: the complete list

rows.source_title: Narodne novine 150/2025 (12.12.2025.): Naredba o iznosima osnovica za obračun doprinosa za obvezna osiguranja za 2026. godinu (Ministarstvo financija)
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (doprinosi samostalnih djelatnosti) [national]
rows.value: Pension 20% and health 16.5% on prescribed minimum monthly bases (coefficients of the average wage). Paid by craftsmen, free professions and flat-rate (paušal) crafts. Zakon o doprinosima; Naredba o iznosima osnovica 2026.

rows.label: Contractor rules: other income (drugi dohodak) and withholding (drugi dohodak) [national]
rows.value: The payer withholds advance tax at the lower rate on receipts less 30% expenses, plus a 10% (or 7.5%) pension contribution, e.g. for authors' fees. Paid by payers of fees to individuals. Zakon o porezu na dohodak; Zakon o doprinosima.

rows.source_title: Porezna uprava: Doprinosi: informiranje o općim pravilima, stopama i poreznom obvezniku (datum ažuriranja: 8. siječnja 2025.)
rows.label: Mandatory second pillar pension (obvezno mirovinsko osiguranje na temelju individualne kapitalizirane štednje (II. stup)) [national]
rows.value: 5% of gross pay (out of the 20% pension contribution). Paid by employees in the second pillar. Zakon o doprinosima.

rows.label: Corporate income tax (porez na dobit) [national]
rows.value: 10% for revenue up to €1,000,000 a year, 18% above; 15% global minimum tax (domestic top-up tax) for groups with revenue of €750 million or more. Paid by companies, branches of foreign companies, and self-employed people with receipts above €1 million. Zakon o porezu na dobit; Zakon o minimalnom globalnom porezu na dobit.

rows.label: Local business tax on the use of public areas (porez na korištenje javnih površina) [municipal]
rows.value: Amount, method and conditions set by each municipality. Paid by businesses and individuals using public areas. Zakon o lokalnim porezima NN 115/16, 101/17, 114/22, 114/23, 152/24.

rows.label: Simplified regime: flat-rate crafts (paušal) (paušalno oporezivanje obrta) [national]
rows.value: 12% of a deemed income by receipts band, paid quarterly. Paid by crafts with receipts up to €60,000 outside the VAT system. Pravilnik o paušalnom oporezivanju samostalnih djelatnosti.

rows.label: Branch profits and distributed profits (poslovna jedinica nerezidenta; porez po odbitku na dividende) [national]
rows.value: No branch profits tax (branches pay 10% or 18% profit tax); 10% withholding on dividends to foreign companies (EU directive and treaty relief available). Paid by branches of foreign companies; companies paying dividends abroad. Zakon o porezu na dobit.

rows.label: Special environmental fee on motor vehicles (posebna naknada za okoliš na vozila na motorni pogon) [national]
rows.value: Initial fee by vehicle category (HRK 33.25 for cars, 76.00 for vans, 304.00 for buses, 456.00 for heavy goods vehicles) times correction coefficients for engine, fuel, CO2 emissions and age (hybrids 0.5); paid yearly. Paid by owners of motor vehicles. Zakon o Fondu za zaštitu okoliša i energetsku učinkovitost art. 16; Uredba NN 114/14, 147/14 and 2/21.

rows.label: Tourist tax (turistička pristojba) [regional]
rows.value: Per person per night, set by each county and the City of Zagreb within national limits: HRK 10.00 to 20.00 (EUR 1.33 to 2.65) from 1 April to 30 September and HRK 7.00 to 14.00 (EUR 0.93 to 1.86) otherwise; camps HRK 8.00 to 15.00 and 5.00 to 10.00; private accommodation pays a yearly lump sum per bed. Paid by overnight guests (collected by the accommodation provider); private hosts pay the lump sum. Zakon o turističkoj pristojbi (NN 52/19, 32/20, 42/20); Pravilnik o najnižem i najvišem iznosu turističke pristojbe (NN 71/19).

rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee (HRT monthly fee) (mjesečna pristojba HRT-a) [national]
rows.value: EUR 10.62 a month per household with a receiver (unchanged since 2012); legal cap 1.5% of the average net monthly wage. Paid by owners or possessors of radio or TV receivers (one fee per household). Zakon o Hrvatskoj radioteleviziji art. 34 and 35.
